cohort: 21,576 children born at < 37 weeks of gestation; 3,596 with hearing loss and 17,980 with normal hearing, matched for sex, age at diagnosis, and enrollment time
finding: Maternal hearing loss, maternal diabetes, preterm birth, and ear malformation were major risk factors for hearing loss in prematurely born children, while cesarean section and combined antenatal steroids and magnesium sulfate were protective.
mod_finding: Prematurely born children who were born via cesarean section exhibited a significantly reduced risk of developing HL.
